name: For Honor
cats: Bulwark Counter or Up to the Hilt Execution
texts: Tace cor tuum! — Silence your heart!
Come Champion! Show me the best your people have to offer.
I am immortal, Champion... Wait and see!
You are a Wolf, Champion. Do you feel it?
I hope you die well, Warrior.
Only Sheep pray for peace, Warrior.
Your skill is impressive, but it will not save you.
You are the first samurai to reach this place, congratulations!
Every path leads you to me.
Perhaps you are who I've been waiting for... Show me!
You were born for this... We all were.
So sentimental... May you never lose that.
Does your heart sing as the bodies fall around you?
I didn't think it would be you...
I will not yield. Not ever!
祇園精舎の鐘の声、諸行無常の響きあり。娑羅双樹の花の色、盛者必衰の理をあらはす。 — Gion shōja no kane no koe, shogyō mujō no hibiki ari. Sara sōju no hana no iro, jōsha hissui no kotowari wo arawasu.
驕れる人も久しからず、ただ春の夜の夢のごとし。猛き者もつひには滅びぬ、ひとへに風の前の塵に同じ。 — Ogoreru hito mo hisashikarazu, tada haru no yo no yume no gotoshi. Takeki mono mo tsui ni wa horobinu, hitoe ni kaze no mae no chiri ni onaji.
